items.title: Michael White interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 10, 2025

ctx.x: Before our tape was rolling we were talking about, you must have had a good reed. And it made me think of a comment that Evan Christopher made. I assume you know Evan Christopher?
He had this interesting comment about New Orleans, in that it was so humid that it affected how you played. And I wondered if he was making that up?
